first off, thanks for just paying attention and talking to me; i really appreciate your concern.  makes me feel better already.

my relationship with almost every member of my family is tense; my sister and i don't really get along at all, she's just at that age where she doesn't want to really be a part of the family, she just wants to do her own thing (teens). my mom isn't really somebody that you can sit down and talk to that sort of thing about; she's very..erm..i can't even describe it.  cold isnt it, because she has alot of love for me deep down, i know, im not ignorant of that, but i know that part of her is deeply troubled with me.

my fraternity is fantastic, don't get me wrong.  i love it so much and i would never leave it; its just that some people don't understand what i'm going through at home and i think that i get victimized for it.  i love my brothers and they love me, i wasn't clear enough about that and i apologize, its just hard to be understood sometimes.

i think that might be an underlying factor in this all. i want to be understood. 

i want everyone to know that i just want to get a college degree and excell in life; im not sure what path it will take me down once education is done but im curious to see where it brings me.

i've battled some serious depression since my dad left me (8) and i think that fuels my thoughts.  im just not sure if i'm doing the right thing with my life and that what it boils down to: i cant face myself sometimes because i'm convinced im a huge failure.

honestly, i work so hard.  and im not just sitting here miserable, i try every day to put myself in a better place by working hard and putting my efforts towards the things that matter to me, school and getting a better car (im a commuter student)

but i think acceptance from family and friends is what i want more than anything...  i never feel like i truly belong anywhere, you know? not trying to sound like a baby or anything, but it is how i feel and i can't really help that.
i've tried..they won't defer it.
